summary: Prepare internal agent-review identity checks with no user-visible effect

replay.detail: No claims, replay or projections change; the resolver has no public caller.

schema.detail: No schema, serialized gate variant or storage version changes.

rules.detail: Internal helpers resolve declared reviewer identities, reject retirement and check known owner/requester exclusions. Public parsing still rejects agent-review.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or publication changes; existing gate and human review behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime behavior or restart-time work changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the internal helpers and tests; no data recovery is needed.
